paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
caption: Classification accuracy on novel real-world classification tasks in .
model_annotation: This vertical bar chart illustrates the classification accuracy of various models on novel real-world classification tasks. The horizontal axis contains the categories representing the models; it lacks an explicit axis label and individual tick labels, with the categories instead identified by a legend on the right and ordered sequentially from left to right. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a truncated linear scale with numeric tick labels ranging from 40% to 65% at regular 5% intervals, accompanied by dashed horizontal grid lines. The chart consists of six individual bars, each corresponding to a specific legend entry. From left to right, the bars are: light gray for "RoBERTa w/o Exp." at approximately 46.5% (the shortest bar), light blue for "ExEnt" at roughly 55%, orange for "LaSQuE (mean)" at about 47%, green for "LaSQuE" also around 47%, purple for "LaSQuE (syn2real)" at approximately 58.5%, and dark gray for "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)" at about 62% (the tallest bar). The bars are not sorted by ascending or descending value, and each is visually outlined with a thin black border for emphasis.
